name: Aurora
description: A night sky washing green into violet, under a frosted panel.
bestFor: Heroes and media where the sky holds the color and the panel stays quiet.
promptFragment: Visual style: Aurora. Paint the ground as a northern-lights gradient, green into teal into violet, and float a dark frosted panel with a mint edge and a soft blur. Type stays a plain sans in near-white. Avoid flat gray, hard comic outlines, and a second busy pattern on the panel. Keep text readable: meet WCAG 2.2 AA contrast (4.5:1) against the surface the text actually sits on. https://www.w3.org/WAI/WCAG22/Understanding/contrast-minimum.html
